controls.title: Controls & Dual-Mode Guide
controls.body:
Move (Side-Scroll / 8-Dir Top-Down): Joystick / WASD / Arrows
Jump, Double Jump & Wall Jump: JUMP / Space (Down+Jump drops one-way bridge)
Sword Slash: ATK / J / Z
Shadow Dodge (i-frames): DODGE / Shift / K
Shadow Guard (Block / Parry): GUARD / C / X (Hold)
Top-Down Sprint: Ctrl / L3 (Hold while moving)
Interact (Rift Gate / Runestone): E / F / RIFT
Switch Camera & Mode: MODE / Tab / M  |  Pause: Esc / Back
hud.hint_sidescroll: Jump, Double-Jump, Wall-Jump, Guard & drop bridges (Down+Jump). Enter a Rift or tap MODE for Top-Down.
hud.hint_topdown: Move in 8 directions, Sprint (Ctrl), Guard, Dodge & examine Runestones. Enter Rift or tap MODE for Side-Scroll.
hud.hint_rift_ready: Shadow Rift in range! Press E / tap RIFT or MODE to shift camera & mode.
hud.hint_lore_ready: Ancient Runestone nearby! Press E or tap RIFT to read its inscription.
lore.west_tablet: West Runestone: "Two realms overlap in the Twilight Sanctum — leap the outer cliffs or walk the inner seal."
lore.east_tablet: East Runestone: "A Shadowblade masters eight winds of step, the silent dodge, and the unyielding ward."
